Tanaji Nathu Khopade vs State Of Maharashtra on 12 February,
2026
Gitalaxmi 915-WP(St
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Writ Petition (Stamp) No. 1724 Of 2026
 Tanaji Nathu Khopade ...Petitioner
 Versus
 The State of Maharashtra ...Respondent
 __________
Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Petitioner.
Mr. Tanveer Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent.

P.C. :
1. Heard Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Petitioner and Mr.
Tanveer Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent.

2. By the present Petition, the Petitioner is seeking to quash First Information Report bearing Crime No. 19 of 2026 dated 16.01.2026 for the offences punishable under Sections 123, 274, 275 & 223 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 along with Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 3(1)(zz)(iv), 30(2)(a) & 59 of the Food Safety &
Standards Act, 2006 registered with Khalapur Police Station, District-Raigad.
3. Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Petitioner submits that the issue involved in the present Petition is pending for consideration before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
He further Gitalaxmi 915-WP(St)-1724-2026.doc submits that similar issues are involved in Criminal Writ Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025.

entities.text: Criminal Writ Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: He refers to the orders passed in the above said Petitions, wherein this Court has admitted the same and granted interim reliefs.

4. Mr. Tanveer Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent does not dispute that the issue involved in the present Petition is subject matter of the Petitions, referred Tanaji Nathu Khopade vs State Of Maharashtra on 12 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109427160/
1 by the Petitioner in the present Petition.

entities.text: Tanaji Nathu Khopade vs State Of Maharashtra
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He submits that the present Petition filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short "BNSS") be tagged along with the aforesaid Petitions.
5. Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Petitioner submits that the interim orders granted in the aforesaid Petitions, be also granted in this Petition.
6. Mr. Tanveer Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent does not object to the said request.
7. In view of the above, further proceedings arising out of Crime No. 19 of 2026 dated 16.01.2026 registered with Khalapur Police Station, District-Raigad, are stayed qua the Petitioner.

8. Tag the present Criminal Writ Petition along with Criminal Writ Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025.
[ASHWIN D. BHOBE, J.] GITALAXMI KRISHNA KRISHNA KOTAWADEKAR KOTAWADEKAR Date:
